Summarize cell-level data to the well / slide level

Source: R/quantify.R
cr_summarize_wells.Rd

Aggregates the per-cell values for a channel to a single number per spatial unit.

Usage

cr_summarize_wells(experiment, channel, fun = stats::median)

Arguments

experiment

A cr_experiment.

channel

Channel name.

fun

Aggregation function. Default stats::median.

Value

A tibble with one row per spatial unit containing well (or slide), n_cells, the aggregated value, and the treatment columns from design.

Examples

exp <- cr_example_experiment(seed = 1, n_cells_per_well = 30)
cr_summarize_wells(exp, channel = "marker_1")
